name: Machine Learning Summer School (MLSS) 2027 Okinawa
funder: Okinawa Institute of Science and Technology (OIST)
amount: Accommodation provided for selected participants (OIST campus housing or shared hotel); travel coverage not stated
eligibility: Mainly Master's/PhD students; small number of researchers, professors and practitioners also considered
eligibility_note: No nationality restriction stated; visa invitation letters provided. Postdoc admission not explicitly mentioned (falls under 'researchers').
deadline: See website (registration via OpenReview expected from Aug 2026)
how_to_apply_tip: Check the Application page immediately - the window may be closing; request a visa invitation letter from mlss2027@oist.jp right after acceptance.

name: HEC Post-Doctoral Fellowship Program (Phase III)
amount: Living allowance (reported ~USD 1,600/month, varies by host country) + one-time health insurance, airfare and research/bench costs – see Financial Support page
eligibility: Age <= 45; local HEC-attested PhD, or foreign PhD + 5 years work in Pakistan; regular employee of HEC-recognized HEI or PCST-recognized R&D org; no previous postdoc (>3 months); placement at QS top-200 university
eligibility_note: Only for Pakistani regular employees of Pakistani HEIs/R&D orgs; foreign-PhD holders need 5 years post-PhD service in Pakistan (local-PhD holders do not)
deadline: Annual – last batch closed 2025-10-30 (check for next batch)
how_to_apply_tip: Secure a placement letter from a QS top-200 supervisor (dated within 6 months) and a 9-month leave NOC before the portal (pdfp.hec.gov.pk) opens.

name: Talented Young Scientist Program (TYSP)
funder: Ministry of Science and Technology of China / China Science and Technology Exchange Center
eligibility: Under 45, doctoral degree and >5 years research experience; hosted by a Chinese university, institute or company
eligibility_note: Programme targets young scientists from developing (Afro-Asian / Belt and Road) countries; Pakistani researchers have been selected (e.g. IUB lecturer, 2026), but exclusion list on official page is garbled – confirm
how_to_apply_tip: The Chinese host institution registers on the TYSP platform and submits your information – find a host by December for the Jan-Mar call.

name: Sindh HEC International Post-Doctoral Fellowship Programme (Phase II)
amount: Living allowance up to USD 1,500/month (PPP-based) + USD 2,000 health insurance + USD 6,000 research/bench fee + PKR 350,000 return airfare
eligibility: HEC-recognized PhD; regular employee of a Sindh public/private HEI; age <= 50; preferably 5 years post-PhD experience in Sindh; placement at QS top-200 (top-500 considered); Digital Innovation is a priority area
eligibility_note: Requires Sindh domicile and PRC (Form C) plus employment at a Sindh HEI
how_to_apply_tip: Arrange the host placement letter first; post the hard copy and email the PDF to ad.qa@sindhhec.gov.pk with all NOCs.

name: PERIDOT – Pakistan-France Hubert Curien Partnership (researcher mobility)
funder: HEC Pakistan & Campus France / French Ministries
amount: Mobility costs (travel/stay) for joint team visits – see website for per-visit amounts
eligibility: PI must be regular faculty (PhD) at a Pakistani public/private HEI (or contract covering project duration) with a French partner who applies in parallel; PhD students integrated
eligibility_note: Bilateral HEC-France programme exclusively for Pakistani university researchers paired with French teams
how_to_apply_tip: Find a French collaborator early – both sides must submit (Campus France + HEC) or the proposal is rejected; recent priority themes are health, energy, agriculture, climate economics, so frame AI as an enabler.

name: Fulbright Scholar Program (Pakistan) – postdoctoral research / lectureship in the US
amount: Airfare, living stipend, health insurance, research allowance + support for one dependent
eligibility: PhD/terminal degree, all fields except clinical medicine; invitation letter from US university; NOT eligible if PhD earned within last 2 years or in US for research/study in last 5 years
eligibility_note: Pakistani citizens living/working in Pakistan; dual US nationals excluded. Profile note: becomes eligible once PhD is >2 years old
deadline: Annual – usually late October (2027 cycle closed 2026-10-28)
how_to_apply_tip: Start emailing US hosts in summer 2027: an invitation letter must be in the application, along with 3 references.

name: TÜBİTAK 2221 Fellowships for Visiting Scientists and Scientists on Sabbatical Leave
amount: Up to TRY 81,000/month (visiting scientist) + one round-trip airfare + health insurance for 3-12 month stays
eligibility: PhD holders working at universities/research institutions abroad; host scientist (full-time, PhD) at a Turkish university or TÜBİTAK centre applies
eligibility_note: TÜBİTAK page states no nationality restriction; aimed at Turkish and other scientists working abroad.
how_to_apply_tip: Four calls a year (next window 2-30 Nov 2026). Register on ARBİS with your passport name; the Turkish host writes the proposal (in Turkish) and submits it.

name: Ernst Mach Grant – Worldwide
funder: OeAD (Austria's Agency for Education and Internationalisation)
amount: Monthly grant (see website) + help with insurance and accommodation; supplementary own funds needed
eligibility: Young researchers (PhD students and postdocs) of all disciplines, aged 35 or under; Austrian host
eligibility_note: OeAD: 'young researchers from all disciplines and countries (except Austria)'.
how_to_apply_tip: Postdocs must show employment at their home university; get a supervision letter from an Austrian host (e.g., TU Wien, JKU Linz) before 1 Dec.

name: ICTP Junior Associates
funder: Abdus Salam International Centre for Theoretical Physics (ICTP)
amount: 3 round-trip travel fares over 6 years + ICTP hospitality during visits
duration: 6-year appointment; 3 visits of 30-60 days (max 180 days total)
eligibility: PhD holders aged 35 or under with main affiliation at an institute in a developing country; fields include Scientific Computing, AI and Data Science (ICOMP)
eligibility_note: ICTP: open to scientists whose main affiliation is in a developing country (Pakistan is a developing country per ICTP/UN lists).
how_to_apply_tip: Needs two recommendation letters from senior scientists (preferably outside your institute); name the ICOMP/Scientific Computing, AI & Data Science section as your target.

name: ICTP Regular Associates
funder: Abdus Salam International Centre for Theoretical Physics (ICTP)
amount: 3 round-trip travel fares over 6 years + ICTP hospitality during visits
duration: 6-year appointment; 3 visits of 30-60 days (max 180 days total)
eligibility: PhD holders aged 36-45 affiliated with an institute in a developing country; includes Scientific Computing, AI and Data Science
eligibility_note: ICTP: main affiliation with a scientific institute in a developing country.
how_to_apply_tip: Use this instead of Junior Associates if you are 36+; plan visits of at least 30 days to qualify for the travel fare.

name: TWAS-FAPESP Postdoctoral Fellowship Programme for Developing Countries
amount: FAPESP postdoctoral fellowship stipend (see call document)
eligibility: PhD within the last 7 years in natural, applied or social sciences (incl. engineering and mathematical sciences); no age limit; host in São Paulo State
eligibility_note: TWAS: open to nationals of 'all developing countries' (TWAS list includes Pakistan).
how_to_apply_tip: Supervisors register expressions of interest by 1 Nov 2026 and the list is published 1 Dec 2026; pick a CS/engineering supervisor from that list, who submits the full proposal by 1 Apr 2027.

name: MSCA Staff Exchanges (secondments)
amount: EUR unit costs per person-month of secondment (see call)
eligibility: Staff of consortium partner organisations (any career stage) actively engaged in the project
eligibility_note: Pakistan is on the Horizon Europe list of low/middle-income countries automatically eligible for funding, so Pakistani partner staff secondments can be funded.
how_to_apply_tip: You cannot apply alone: join an EU-led consortium as a Pakistani partner. Contact EU AI groups now, since the 2027 call is expected to open 15 Dec 2026.

name: JSPS Invitational Fellowships for Research in Japan (Short-term)
funder: Japan Society for the Promotion of Science (JSPS)
amount: JPY 18,000 per day + round-trip economy airfare + travel insurance + up to JPY 150,000 research support (host)
eligibility: Full-time researcher at a foreign university/institute at a position equivalent to assistant professor or above, OR 6+ years since PhD; host researcher in Japan applies
eligibility_note: JSPS: candidates must be citizens or permanent residents of a country with diplomatic relations with Japan (Pakistan qualifies).
how_to_apply_tip: The Japanese host submits (forms S-1 to S-3); host institutions set internal deadlines up to a month earlier than JSPS's 23 Apr 2027 round (arrival Oct 2027–Mar 2028). Being an assistant professor in Pakistan meets the career rule.

name: ERCIM Alain Bensoussan Fellowship Programme
funder: European Research Consortium for Informatics and Mathematics (ERCIM)
amount: Partial funding for living expenses at the host institute (see website)
eligibility: Recent PhD holders in computer science, informatics, applied mathematics
eligibility_note: ERCIM: fellowships 'for PhD holders from all over the world'.
how_to_apply_tip: Register on the site for round alerts and contact a researcher at an ERCIM member institute (e.g., Inria, CWI, SINTEF) before applying.

name: Training and Research in Italian Laboratories (TRIL)
amount: EUR 1,500/month (PhD <5 yrs) or EUR 1,600/month (PhD >5 yrs) + prepaid travel ticket + medical insurance
duration: A few months to 12 months (max 24 incl. extensions)
eligibility: Nationals of and residents in a developing country with at least a Master's; physics-related fields incl. computational physics, wireless ICT/IoT, digital fabrication
eligibility_note: ICTP: applicants must be nationals of a developing country and live in one when selected; developed-country individuals are not eligible.
how_to_apply_tip: Find an Italian lab among ICTP's 400+ partner institutes first and get them to agree to co-fund; frame AI work within computational physics or ICT/IoT.
